# FieldPad: HVAC service records for solo operators

Public App Store version: 1.0.1. Version 1.1 and its optional FieldPad Cloud, QuickBooks Online and Stripe integrations are under validation, not generally available.

U.S. public App Store list prices: $29.99/month and $249.99/year. A free tier is available. The Apple purchase sheet is authoritative for localized prices and available plans.

Core workflow: customers, equipment history, service jobs, estimates, invoices and refrigerant records. Local work supports offline use; sync, address lookup, purchases and connected services require connectivity.

For covered appliances, the leak-rate threshold is 10% for comfort cooling, 20% for commercial refrigeration and 30% for industrial process refrigeration. Part 82 leak repair generally covers ODS appliances with at least 50 lb full charge. Part 84 leak repair generally covers qualifying HFC appliances with at least 15 lb; residential/light-commercial AC and heat pumps are excluded. Certification, recovery and venting duties are separate. See 40 CFR 82.157 and 84.106.

FieldPad is a recordkeeping tool, not EPA approval or a guarantee of legal compliance. A2L checklists and refrigerant-cost calculators are decision aids.
